environment.description: Laravel 10 on AWS ECS Fargate with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in task definition). The /storage/app/exports volume is an ephemeral tmpfs mount with 'nosuid,nodev,noexec' options configured via ECS volume mount. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with row-level security policies active: the database role used by the application (tenant_app_role) has a connection-level variable app.current_tenant set via a Laravel middleware that issues SET LOCAL, and all tables have RLS policies of the form 'USING (tenant_id = current_setting(''app.current_tenant'')::uuid)' with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled on the role. Additionally, the ECS task runs with a custom seccomp profile that filters the symlink(2), symlinkat(2), and link(2) syscalls (returns EPERM), applied via the linuxParameters.seccompProfile field in the container definition pointing to a profile stored in SSM Parameter Store.

db_config.middleware_sets: SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = :tenant_id on every request
